entities.name: Daniel E. Garcia

entities.summary: Daniel Elias Garcia is an American Catholic prelate who has been bishop of Austin since 2025. He was an auxiliary bishop for the diocese from 2015 to 2019 and bishop of Monterey in California from 2019 to 2025.
